entries.source: Chartularium Sangallense III, Nr. 1521, S. 389., Nr. 1521, S. 389
entries.german:
Abt Berchtold und der Konvent von St. Gallen übertragen dem Kloster Rüti das Gut in Hirsindau.

In nomine domini amen. Nos Berchtoldus dei gratia abbas 1, Manegoldus decanus 2, Albertus prepositus 3 totusque conventus monasterii sancti Galli ordinis sancti Benedicti Const(antiensis) dyocesis venerabilibus in Christo preposito et conventui monasterii de Ruti 4 ordinis Premonstratensis eiusdem dyocesis salutem et sinceram in domino caritatem. Licet res ecclesiasticas alienari non liceat, non tamen prohibitum intelligitur, res huiusmodi, que a laicis detinentur, ad usum ecclesiasticum revocare. Ius enim canonicum libenter amplectitur, si, quod est spirituale vel spirituali annexum, a layco ad ecclesiam revertatur. Ea itaque consideracione caritati vestre benigno concurrentes affectu bonum in Hirsindowe 5 predium utique monasterii nostri, sicut illud a quondam Kraftone milite et fratre suo Friderico de Toggenburg 6 feodatoriis nostris pro certa peccunie summa comparastis, vobis et monasterio vestro auctoritate presencium liberaliter concedimus cum omnibus iuribus et pertineneiis suis perpetuo possidendum. Verum ne proprietas eiusdem boni monasterio nostro aliquatenus possit deperire, annuum censum unius libre cere vobis et monasterio vestro pro ipso imponimus custodi monasterii nostri, qui pro tempore fuerit, in festo sancti Galli singulis annis persolvendum. Ut autem hec predicta concessio robur obtineat firmitatis, presentem paginam sigillis nostris fecimus consignari. Actum anno domini M°CC°LIIII°, VI kln. octobr., ind. XIII. Testes sunt hii: Ru od. nobilis de Gutinger a)7, Eglolfus de Rosenberg 8, Ru od. de Rorschach 9, Dietricus de Munchwiler 10, Cu onr. de Horwen 11 et alii quamplures.
entries.english:
Abbot Berchtold and the convent of St. Gall transfer the estate at Hirsindau to Rüti Monastery.

In the name of the Lord, amen. We, Berchtold, by the grace of God abbot; Manegold, dean; Albert, provost; and the whole convent of the monastery of St. Gall, of the Order of St. Benedict in the diocese of Constance, greet in Christ the venerable provost and convent of Rüti Monastery, of the Premonstratensian Order in the same diocese, and offer sincere love in the Lord. Although ecclesiastical property may not be alienated, it is not forbidden to restore to ecclesiastical use property held by laymen; canon law gladly embraces the return to the Church of what is spiritual or attached to spiritual things. Therefore, moved by this consideration and with kindly affection toward you, we freely grant by this charter to you and your monastery, to possess forever with all its rights and appurtenances, the estate at Hirsindau belonging to our monastery, which you purchased for a certain sum from the late Ritter Kraft and his brother Friedrich von Toggenburg, our feudal tenants. Yet, so that ownership of this estate may in no way be lost to our monastery, we impose upon you and your monastery an annual rent of one pound of wax, payable to the keeper of our monastery in office at the time, every year on the feast of St. Gall. To make this grant firm, we have caused this charter to be sealed with our seals. Enacted in the year of the Lord 1254, on the sixth day before the Kalends of October, indiction 13. Witnesses: Ruod, nobleman of Güttingen; Eglolfus of Rosenberg; Ruod of Rorschach; Dietricus of Münchwilen; Cunradus of Horwen, and many others.
